test_cases.title: GGA Sentence Parsing - Valid Fix
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture with no external dependencies.
procedure: Construct a known-good GGA sentence string with fixed latitude, longitude, altitude, satellite count, and fix quality fields.
Pass the sentence buffer to the NMEA library GGA parse function.
Read each output field from the populated GGA result struct.
Compare each output field against the expected value derived from the input.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse function returns success and the GGA result struct latitude, longitude, altitude, satellite count, and fix quality fields equal the expected values from the input sentence.

test_cases.title: GGA Sentence Parsing - Southern and Western Hemispheres
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence with hemisphere indicators 'S' for latitude and 'W' for longitude.
Invoke the NMEA library GGA parse function on the sentence.
Read the parsed latitude and longitude scalar values.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed latitude is negative and parsed longitude is negative, with magnitudes matching the input within 1e-6 degrees.

test_cases.title: RMC Sentence Parsing - Valid Fix
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a known-good RMC sentence with fixed latitude, longitude, ground speed, course, and UTC time.
Pass the sentence buffer to the NMEA library RMC parse function.
Read each output field from the populated RMC result struct.
Compare each output field against the expected value derived from the input.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse function returns success and the RMC result struct latitude, longitude, ground speed, course, and UTC time fields equal the expected values from the input sentence.

test_cases.title: Checksum Validation - Valid Sentence Accepted
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Compute the correct XOR checksum for a known GGA sentence body.
Append the correct '*HH' checksum suffix to the sentence.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the full sentence string.
Inspect the returned status.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse entry point returns success status and produces a populated parsed-output struct.

test_cases.title: Checksum Validation - Mismatched Checksum Rejected
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a syntactically valid GGA sentence body.
Replace the correct '*HH' checksum suffix with an intentionally incorrect two-digit hex value.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the corrupted sentence.
Inspect the returned status code.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse entry point returns a non-success error status indicating a checksum mismatch and does not populate the parsed-output struct with sentence values.

test_cases.title: Checksum Validation - Missing Checksum Rejected
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence body with no '*HH' checksum suffix appended.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the sentence.
Inspect the returned status code.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse entry point returns a non-success error status and does not populate parsed-output fields.

test_cases.title: Decimal Degrees Conversion - Latitude
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose latitude field is the literal '4807.038,N' (48 degrees 7.038 minutes North).
Invoke the NMEA library GGA parse function.
Read the parsed latitude scalar from the result struct.
Compare the scalar against the expected decimal degree value 48.1173.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed latitude scalar equals 48.1173 within an absolute tolerance of 1e-4 decimal degrees.

test_cases.title: Decimal Degrees Conversion - Longitude
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose longitude field is the literal '01131.000,E' (11 degrees 31.000 minutes East).
Invoke the NMEA library GGA parse function.
Read the parsed longitude scalar from the result struct.
Compare the scalar against the expected decimal degree value 11.5167.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed longitude scalar equals 11.5167 within an absolute tolerance of 1e-4 decimal degrees.

test_cases.title: Altitude Reported In Meters
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose altitude field is '545.4' with the unit indicator 'M' (meters).
Invoke the NMEA library GGA parse function.
Read the altitude scalar from the parsed result struct.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed altitude scalar equals 545.4 within 1e-3 meters and the parser exposes the value with no unit conversion applied.

test_cases.title: Ground Speed Knots-to-Meters-per-Second Conversion
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct an RMC sentence whose ground speed field is exactly '10.0' knots.
Invoke the NMEA library RMC parse function on the sentence.
Read the ground speed scalar from the parsed result struct.
Compare the scalar against the expected meters-per-second value 5.14444.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed ground speed scalar equals 5.14444 m/s within an absolute tolerance of 1e-3 m/s (one knot equals 0.514444 m/s).

test_cases.title: UTC Time Extraction From GGA
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose UTC time field is '123519' (12:35:19 UTC).
Invoke the NMEA library GGA parse function.
Read the UTC time fields (hours, minutes, seconds) from the parsed result struct.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed UTC fields equal hours=12, minutes=35, seconds=19 exactly.

test_cases.title: UTC Time Extraction From RMC
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct an RMC sentence whose UTC time field is '225446' (22:54:46 UTC).
Invoke the NMEA library RMC parse function.
Read the UTC time fields (hours, minutes, seconds) from the parsed result struct.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parsed UTC fields equal hours=22, minutes=54, seconds=46 exactly.

test_cases.title: Sentence Type Identification - GGA vs RMC vs Other
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Pass a sentence beginning with '$GPGGA' to the NMEA library type-identification entry point and record the returned sentence-type enum.
Pass a sentence beginning with '$GPRMC' to the NMEA library type-identification entry point and record the returned sentence-type enum.
Pass a sentence beginning with '$GPGSV' (an unsupported type) to the NMEA library type-identification entry point and record the returned sentence-type enum or status.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: GGA input yields the GGA sentence-type identifier, RMC input yields the RMC sentence-type identifier, and the unsupported sentence is identified as a non-GGA, non-RMC type (or returns an unknown-type status).

test_cases.title: Reject Malformed Numeric Field
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose latitude field contains the non-numeric token 'ABCD.EFG'.
Recompute and append a correct checksum so that checksum validation does not mask the field error.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the sentence.
Inspect the returned status code.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse entry point returns a non-success error status indicating malformed input and does not populate the parsed-output struct with sentence values.

test_cases.title: Reject Out-of-Bounds Field
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a GGA sentence whose latitude field encodes a value greater than 90 degrees (e.g. '9901.000,N').
Recompute and append a correct checksum to isolate the field validation.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the sentence.
Inspect the returned status code.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Parse entry point returns a non-success error status indicating an out-of-bounds field and does not populate the parsed-output struct with sentence values.

test_cases.title: Deterministic Parsing - Repeated Identical Inputs
test_cases.setup: Instantiate the NMEA parser in a Google Test fixture.
procedure: Construct a known-good GGA sentence buffer.
Invoke the NMEA library parse entry point on the buffer and capture the populated result struct (call A).
Without modifying any state, invoke the parse entry point again on the same buffer and capture the populated result struct (call B).
Repeat the parse a third time and capture the result struct (call C).
Byte-compare result structs A, B, and C.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Result structs A, B, and C are byte-identical for all parsed fields and all calls return the same status code.

test_cases.title: POSIX and Pico2 Parser Output Equivalence
test_cases.setup: Build the NMEA library and its Google Test suite for both the POSIX target and the Pico2 target. Capture the parsed-output structs (or their serialized byte representations) emitted by the same parametrized test inputs on each target.
procedure: Run the NMEA Google Test suite on the POSIX build and write the captured parsed-output bytes to a fixture artifact.
Run the NMEA Google Test suite on the Pico2 build (or its host-mode equivalent) and write the captured parsed-output bytes to a fixture artifact.
Programmatically byte-compare the two artifacts inside a Google Test that loads both fixtures and asserts equality.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: The byte-comparison Google Test passes: every parsed-output field for every input sentence is identical between the POSIX and Pico2 captures.
